descriptions.text: Talisman of the Slate Butterfly. Those who remember and commemorate the sad tale of the Slate Butterfly are given a boon by the fairies of the world. That story even made me cry. Adds +4 to the Light on Your Feet skill. Adds +1 to Intelligence. Winged fairies will no longer be automatically hostile toward you.

recap.text: Donut's gold box holds twenty-five mana potions and a silver butterfly collar charm that jingles. Carl says people put bells on cats so birds hear them coming, but Donut wears it and has the zoomies atop the plastic tubes for ten minutes. In the moonshine room, she teleports between two winged fairies and turns them white, while the other forty or so stay red. She walks the pair toward Carl, telling them of a horrible slaughter.

Donut likes her butterfly charm: fairies like her, it is pretty, and it keeps her Light On Your Feet at ten. It was instrumental against the first Krakaren. The system limits how many magical items she can wear, so to order the guards of Point Mongo around she has to put on the new settlement charm with its tiny turquoise gem. Carl tells her she can switch back if they come across some fairy-class mobs.

beats.headline: A bell for a cat
beats.text: Donut's gold magic item box, for being one of the first hundred crawlers to level Magic Missile to three, holds twenty-five mana potions and a collar charm: a little silver butterfly with a ring to attach it, which jingles when it moves. Donut squeaks with delight. Carl points out that people put bells on cats so the birds and squirrels can hear them coming. It's adorable, Donut says, and she is wearing it. With her Light on Your Feet raised from three to seven, she bounds to the top of the play area's plastic tubes and has the zoomies for ten minutes.
beats.gist: Donut's gold box holds a silver butterfly charm that jingles; she wears it and zooms around the tubes.

beats.headline: Plan Pied Piper
beats.text: The soccer-mom fairies who run the moonshine room are winged, so Donut can turn their dots white. She teleports in between the two of them, and they fall under her charm at once. Get back to work, one shouts at the clurichauns: this is a client, not an enemy. The other forty or so are not airborne fairies and stay red, so it is plan B, which Donut insists is called Plan Pied Piper. She walks the two fairies toward Carl, telling them about a horrible slaughter, and invites everyone to come and see.
beats.gist: Donut charms the two winged fairies, then walks them toward Carl, since the other forty stay red.

beats.headline: One charm too many
beats.text: Donut likes her butterfly charm. Fairies like her, it is pretty, and it is part of her fit. She has had it since the first floor, it was instrumental against the first Krakaren, and it keeps her Light On Your Feet at ten. But the system only lets her wear so many magical items, and to order the guards of Point Mongo around she has to wear the new settlement charm with its tiny turquoise gem. Carl tells her she can always switch back if they come across some fairy-class mobs.
beats.gist: Donut wears the settlement charm, not her butterfly charm, so Point Mongo's guards obey her.

relations.note: together they make her jingle when she walks
